figurative_meaning_en: To feel a burning sensation in the body; to become angry
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা শুনে আমার গায়ে বিষ ছড়ানো লাগল।
সেই অপমানের পর তার গায়ে বিষ ঢালা হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Hearing his words made poison spread on my body, I was furious.
After that insult, he felt like poison was poured on his body, burning with anger.
note: This idiom uses the metaphor of poison causing physical irritation to express intense emotional anger, common in Bengali oral traditions.
